title: The End of the Beginning

canonicalEdition.name: First edition
canonicalEdition.sourceProvenance: Frozen web bundle only: bibliographic records, table-of-contents evidence, official publication metadata, and narrow secondary summary support. Paraphrase-first; no full text frozen.

anchorSummary: The book closes by reframing the exit and transition period as the point where the CEO's lived struggle becomes a set of durable lessons rather than just a sequence of scars.
coreClaim: A successful exit or transition does not erase the struggle; it reframes it and reveals which leadership lessons are durable beyond the immediate survival fight.
distinctMechanism: Horowitz uses the sale and transition period to show that endings are not simple victories but handoffs where the operator has to interpret what the hard years actually taught.
requiredAnchors: Acquisition and transition close the startup chapter without making the earlier pain irrelevant.
The ending becomes a leadership reflection on which lessons remain valid after the existential phase.
The chapter gives closure by turning lived struggle into durable operating principles.
specificApplications: Use endings to identify which leadership lessons travel beyond the original company crisis.
Separate outcome celebration from reflective learning.
Treat transition as another leadership test rather than a clean release from responsibility.
commonMisreadings: Reading the ending as simple triumph rather than as a transition with retained scars and lessons.
Treating the final chapter as an afterthought instead of the moment that consolidates the book's operating logic.
hardEdgeRequirement: Hard mode must show why success after prolonged struggle still leaves unresolved costs, tradeoffs, and identity shifts for the leader.
thresholdQuestion: What remains true after the crisis passes and the role that defined you begins to change?
